scope: Independent read-only static review of staged contextual help193/194 V2; not applied acceptance or a browser execution report.

findings.finding: All18 navigation views other than the guide itself have explicitly allowlisted guide-view destinations. Nine workflow article anchors have h3 headings; nine admin destinations have real h4 headings under the Admin Tools h3. Existing10 guide-map destinations remain allowlisted.

The contextual control is a native anchor with href, target=_blank and rel=noopener noreferrer. Its accessible name includes the section and new-tab disclosure. No click handler replaces the working view or serializes draft state; preserving the existing tab is the intended return route. Browser dirty-draft preservation still requires executed evidence.

setHeader derives the destination from a fixed active-view allowlist, removes query parameters and replaces the entire hash. No record IDs, filenames, entered search terms or draft values enter the generated guide URL.

revealGuideSection checks active user-guide view and connected view-root containment, targets h3 or h4 with programmatic tabindex=-1, cancels restoration and focuses without intermediate scroll before revealing the section. This supports meaningful keyboard landing and does not add every heading to sequential tab order.
The guide introduction explicitly explains the separate guide tab and closing it to return. Neutral Operating guide copy replaces the prior No-brainer operating guide wording.

The new CSS scopes help-link behavior, explicitly respects hidden, permits wrapping, supplies minimum44px height and suppresses the help control in print. Existing topbar flex-wrap and min-width rules remain. h4 styling uses defined light/dark color tokens and retains the previous strong-label spacing.

Accounts wording matches existing create-role options and recovery controls, and avoids promising activation or role-edit controls. Unit wording correctly separates Add unit registry creation from monthly postings, matching the current More/Manage units labels. Past-duty step labels match the implemented shared import workflow.

Diagnostics guidance correctly identifies Shareable diagnostics JSON and does not equate counts with service health. Recycle guidance identifies batch labels, restore conflicts, separate permanent-delete confirmation and read-only refresh. Limits and Compute Settings labels were cross-read against current source, including Save limits, Device preferences and Test Device.

Viewed the existing V2 Chromium320light accounts screenshot: focused Login Accounts heading has a visible outline, body copy wraps within the card, and admin task cards are readable. This image is from a run with a failed overall fixture initialization report and does not establish a passing matrix or entire-page geometry.

acceptance_remaining: 193 requires terminal observed task-to-help navigation outcomes tied to the applied build, fixture role and state; this review ran no browsers.

194 requires revised instructions matched to verified implemented states. Limits and Compute instructions have source support but still need the requested fresh read-only rendering evidence. The inherited detailed scheduling instructions are not newly certified by this review.
Current production source remains the pre-integration baseline at review time. Staged source/typecheck/API parity does not prove integrated runtime behavior.
Native screen-reader announcement, physical-device behavior and native zoom were not performed. Source-level focus semantics are not an accessibility conformance certification.
nonblocking_followups: The visible Section help label does not itself disclose the new-tab behavior; the accessible name and guide introduction do. Consider a visible new-tab indicator or concise visible disclosure as a further usability refinement after runtime checks.

Public help is discoverable for restricted admin sections inside the user guide. It does not provide operational controls or change permission checks; this review does not assess server authorization.
actions_performed: Read staged/current source, manifest and acceptance definitions; cross-read implemented control labels and prior verification-reference headers; inspected one existing screenshot. Wrote this report only. No product, ledger, old evidence, browser/build or backend edits.
